+def parse(argv: list[str]) -> tuple[Opts, list[str]]:

+        if not arg.startswith("-") or arg == "-":

+            i += 1

+            nameval = arg[2:]
+            if "=" in nameval:

+            else:
+                name, value = nameval, None
+            canonical = {"colour": "color", "colour-scale": "color-scale", "colour-scale-mode": "color-scale-mode"}.get(name, name)

+                if canonical in {"classify", "color", "icons"}:
+                    value = "auto"

+        case "classify": o.classify = value or "auto"
+        case "color": o.color = value or "auto"
+        case "header": o.header = True
+        case "bytes": o.bytes = True
+        case "binary": o.binary = True
+        case "group": o.no_group = False
+        case "numeric": o.numeric = True
+        case "no-permissions": o.no_permissions = True
+        case "no-filesize": o.no_filesize = True
+        case "no-user": o.no_user = True
+        case "no-time": o.no_time = True
+        case "stdin": o.stdin = True
+        case "absolute": o.absolute = value or "on"
+        case "follow-symlinks": o.follow_symlinks = True
+        case "git" | "no-git" | "git-repos" | "git-repos-no-status" | "icons" | "width" | "hyperlink" | "dereference" | "color-scale" | "color-scale-mode" | "links" | "inode" | "blocksize" | "modified" | "accessed" | "created" | "changed" | "time" | "time-style" | "total-size" | "octal-permissions" | "mounts" | "smart-group" | "extended" | "context" | "flags" | "no-quotes":
+            return
+        case _:
+            raise CliError(f"Unknown option --{name}")
+
+
+def apply_short(o: Opts, ch: str, value: str | None):
+    match ch:
+        case "?": print(HELP, end=""); raise SystemExit(0)
+        case "v": print(VERSION, end=""); raise SystemExit(0)
+        case "1": o.mode = "lines"
+        case "l": o.long = True; o.mode = "long"
+        case "G" | "x": o.mode = "lines"
+        case "R": o.recurse = True
+        case "T": o.tree = True; o.recurse = True

+        case "A": o.all_count = max(o.all_count, 1)

+        case "f": o.only_files = True
+        case "L": o.level = parse_int(value or "", "-L")
+        case "r": o.reverse = True
+        case "s": set_sort(o, value or "")
+        case "I": o.ignore_globs.extend((value or "").split("|"))

+        case "b": o.binary = True
+        case "B": o.bytes = True
+        case "g": o.no_group = False
+        case "h": o.header = True
+        case "n": o.numeric = True
+        case "X" | "w" | "H" | "i" | "S" | "t" | "m" | "u" | "U" | "o" | "M" | "@" | "Z" | "O":
+            return
+        case _:
+            raise CliError(f"Unknown option -{ch}")
+
+
+def parse_int(s: str, opt: str) -> int:
+    try:
+        return int(s)
+    except ValueError:
+        raise CliError(f"Value {s!r} not valid for option {opt}: invalid digit found in string")
+
+
+def set_sort(o: Opts, value: str):
+    if value not in SORT_FIELDS:

+@dataclass
+class Entry:
+    path: Path
+    display: str
+    st: os.stat_result | None
+    lst: os.stat_result | None
+    missing: bool = False
+
+    @property
+    def name(self) -> str:
+        return self.path.name or str(self.path)
+
+    @property
+    def is_link(self) -> bool:
+        return self.lst is not None and stat.S_ISLNK(self.lst.st_mode)
+
+    @property
+    def is_dir(self) -> bool:
+        try:
+            return self.path.is_dir()
+        except OSError:
+            return False
+
+    @property
+    def is_file(self) -> bool:
+        return self.st is not None and stat.S_ISREG(self.st.st_mode)
+
+
+def make_entry(path: Path, display: str | None = None) -> Entry:
+    try:
+        lst = path.lstat()
+        st = path.stat()
+        return Entry(path, display if display is not None else str(path), st, lst)
+    except OSError:
+        return Entry(path, display if display is not None else str(path), None, None, True)
+
+
+def visible_name(e: Entry, opts: Opts, link_paths: bool = True) -> str:
+    if opts.absolute == "on":
+        base = str(e.path.resolve(strict=False))
+    else:
+        base = e.display
+    if link_paths and e.is_link:
+        try:
+            base += " -> " + os.readlink(e.path)
+        except OSError:
+            pass
+    if opts.classify == "always":
+        if e.is_dir:
+            base += "/"
+        elif e.is_link:
+            base += "@"
+        elif e.st and (e.st.st_mode & stat.S_IXUSR):
+            base += "*"
+    return base
+
+
+def should_skip_name(name: str, opts: Opts) -> bool:
+    if opts.all_count == 0 and name.startswith("."):
+        return True
+    return any(pat and fnmatch.fnmatch(name, pat) for pat in opts.ignore_globs)
+
+
+def list_dir(path: Path, opts: Opts) -> list[Entry]:
+    entries: list[Entry] = []
+    if opts.all_count >= 2:
+        entries.extend([make_entry(path / ".", "."), make_entry(path / "..", "..")])
+    try:
+        names = list(os.listdir(path))
+    except OSError as exc:
+        raise exc
+    for name in names:
+        if should_skip_name(name, opts):
+            continue
+        e = make_entry(path / name, name)
+        if filtered(e, opts):
+            continue
+        entries.append(e)
+    return sort_entries(entries, opts)
+
+
+def filtered(e: Entry, opts: Opts) -> bool:
+    is_link = e.is_link
+    is_dir = e.is_dir
+    is_file = e.is_file
+    if opts.no_symlinks and is_link:
+        return True
+    if opts.only_dirs and not is_dir:
+        return True
+    if opts.only_files and not is_file and not (opts.show_symlinks and is_link):
+        return True
+    return False
+
+
+def sort_entries(entries: list[Entry], opts: Opts) -> list[Entry]:
+    def key(e: Entry):
+        dir_group = 0
+        if opts.dirs_first:
+            dir_group = 0 if e.is_dir else 1
+        elif opts.dirs_last:
+            dir_group = 1 if e.is_dir else 0
+        sf = opts.sort
+        if sf in {"none"}:
+            val = 0
+        elif sf == "size":
+            val = e.st.st_size if e.st else -1
+        elif sf in {"modified", "newest"}:
+            val = -(e.st.st_mtime if e.st else 0)
+        elif sf == "oldest":
+            val = e.st.st_mtime if e.st else 0
+        elif sf in {"extension", "Extension"}:
+            ext = e.name.rsplit(".", 1)[1] if "." in e.name else ""
+            val = (ext if sf == "Extension" else ext.lower(), e.name.lower())
+        elif sf == "type":
+            val = (0 if e.is_dir else 1 if e.is_file else 2, e.name.lower())
+        elif sf == "Name":
+            val = e.name
+        else:
+            val = e.name.lower()
+        return (dir_group, val, e.name.lower())
+    out = sorted(entries, key=key)
+    if opts.reverse:
+        out.reverse()
+    return out
+
+
+def mode_string(e: Entry) -> str:
+    if e.st is None:
+        return "?????"
+    if os.name == "nt":
+        first = "d" if e.is_dir else "l" if e.is_link else "-"
+        readonly = bool(e.st.st_file_attributes & getattr(stat, "FILE_ATTRIBUTE_READONLY", 1)) if hasattr(e.st, "st_file_attributes") else False
+        return first + ("-" if readonly else "a") + "---"
+    m = e.st.st_mode
+    first = "d" if stat.S_ISDIR(m) else "l" if stat.S_ISLNK(m) else "-"
+    bits = ""
+    for r, w, x in [(stat.S_IRUSR, stat.S_IWUSR, stat.S_IXUSR), (stat.S_IRGRP, stat.S_IWGRP, stat.S_IXGRP), (stat.S_IROTH, stat.S_IWOTH, stat.S_IXOTH)]:
+        bits += "r" if m & r else "-"
+        bits += "w" if m & w else "-"
+        bits += "x" if m & x else "-"
+    return first + bits
+
+
+def size_string(e: Entry, opts: Opts) -> str:
+    if e.st is None or e.is_dir:
+        return "-"
+    n = e.st.st_size
+    if opts.bytes or n < 1000:
+        return str(n)
+    units = [(10**12, "T"), (10**9, "G"), (10**6, "M"), (10**3, "k")]
+    if opts.binary:
+        units = [(1024**4, "T"), (1024**3, "G"), (1024**2, "M"), (1024, "K")]
+    for div, suf in units:
+        if n >= div:
+            v = n / div
+            return (f"{v:.1f}" if v < 10 else str(round(v))) + suf
+    return str(n)
+
+
+def time_string(e: Entry) -> str:
+    if e.st is None:
+        return "-"
+    dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(e.st.st_mtime)
+    return f"{dt.day:2d} {dt.strftime('%b')} {dt.year:5d}"
+
+
+def long_rows(entries: list[Entry], opts: Opts) -> list[list[str]]:
+    rows: list[list[str]] = []
+    if opts.header:
+        h = []
+        if not opts.no_permissions: h.append("Mode" if os.name == "nt" else "Permissions")
+        if not opts.no_filesize: h.append("Size")
+        if not opts.no_user: h.append("User")
+        if not opts.no_group: h.append("Group")
+        if not opts.no_time: h.append("Date Modified")
+        h.append("Name")
+        rows.append(h)
+    for e in entries:
+        r = []
+        if not opts.no_permissions: r.append(mode_string(e))
+        if not opts.no_filesize: r.append(size_string(e, opts))
+        if not opts.no_user: r.append(user_string())
+        if not opts.no_group: r.append(group_string())
+        if not opts.no_time: r.append(time_string(e))
+        r.append(visible_name(e, opts, True))
+        rows.append(r)
+    return rows
+
+
+def user_string() -> str:
+    if os.name == "nt":
+        return ""
+    try:
+        import pwd
+        return pwd.getpwuid(os.getuid()).pw_name
+    except Exception:
+        return str(os.getuid() if hasattr(os, "getuid") else "")
+
+
+def group_string() -> str:
+    if os.name == "nt":
+        return ""
+    try:
+        import grp
+        return grp.getgrgid(os.getgid()).gr_name
+    except Exception:
+        return str(os.getgid() if hasattr(os, "getgid") else "")
+
+
+def render_long(entries: list[Entry], opts: Opts) -> str:
+    rows = long_rows(entries, opts)
+    if not rows:
+        return ""
+    cols = max(len(r) for r in rows)
+    widths = [0] * cols
+    for r in rows:
+        for i, c in enumerate(r):
+            widths[i] = max(widths[i], len(c))
+    lines = []
+    for r in rows:
+        parts = []
+        for i, c in enumerate(r):
+            if i == len(r) - 1:
+                parts.append(c)
+            elif column_is_right(i, opts):
+                parts.append(c.rjust(widths[i]))
+            else:
+                parts.append(c.ljust(widths[i]))
+        lines.append(" ".join(parts).rstrip())
+    return "\n".join(lines) + ("\n" if lines else "")
+
+
+def column_is_right(index: int, opts: Opts) -> bool:
+    cols = []
+    if not opts.no_permissions: cols.append("mode")
+    if not opts.no_filesize: cols.append("size")
+    if not opts.no_user: cols.append("user")
+    if not opts.no_group: cols.append("group")
+    if not opts.no_time: cols.append("time")
+    return index < len(cols) and cols[index] == "size"
+
+
+def render_lines(entries: list[Entry], opts: Opts) -> str:
+    return "".join(visible_name(e, opts, True) + "\n" for e in entries)
+
+
+def render_tree(root: Entry, opts: Opts) -> str:
+    lines = [visible_name(root, opts, False)]
+    def walk(path: Path, prefix: str, depth: int):
+        if opts.level is not None and depth > opts.level:
+            return
+        try:
+            children = list_dir(path, opts)
+        except OSError:
+            return
+        for idx, child in enumerate(children):
+            last = idx == len(children) - 1
+            branch = "└── " if last else "├── "
+            lines.append(prefix + branch + visible_name(child, opts, True))
+            if child.is_dir and not child.is_link:
+                walk(child.path, prefix + ("    " if last else "│   "), depth + 1)
+    if root.is_dir:
+        walk(root.path, "", 1)
+    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
+
+
+def collect_top(paths: list[str], opts: Opts) -> tuple[list[Entry], list[str]]:
+    entries: list[Entry] = []
+    errors: list[str] = []
+    multiple = len(paths) > 1
+    blocks: list[Entry] = []
+    for p in paths:
+        path = Path(p)

+class EzaError(Exception):
+    def __init__(self, msg, code=3):

+def display_width(s):
+    return sum(2 if ord(c) > 0xFFFF else 1 for c in strip_ansi(s))

+def strip_ansi(s):
+    return re.sub(r"\x1b\[[0-9;]*m", "", s)

+
+def nat_key(s, case_sensitive=False, strip_dot=False):
+    if strip_dot and s.startswith('.'):
+        s = s[1:]
+    if not case_sensitive:
+        s = s.lower()
+    parts = re.split(r"(\d+)", s)
+    return tuple((0, int(p)) if p.isdigit() else (1, p) for p in parts)

+def quote_name(name, no_quotes=False):
+    if no_quotes or not any(c.isspace() for c in name):
+        return name
+    if "'" not in name:
+        return "'" + name + "'"
+    return '"' + name.replace('"', '\\"') + '"'

+def icon_for(path, is_dir):
+    if is_dir:
+        return "󰉋"
+    return "󰡯"

+def parse(argv):
+    opt = Opt()
+    paths = []
+    i = 0
+    while i < len(argv):
+        a = argv[i]
+        if a == "--":
+            paths += argv[i+1:]
+            break
+        if a.startswith("--") and len(a) > 2:
+            word = a[2:]
+            val = None
+            if "=" in word:
+                word, val = word.split("=", 1)
+            if word not in LONGS:
+                raise EzaError(f"Unknown argument --{word}")
+            need = TAKES.get(word, "forbidden")
+            if need == "required" and val is None:
+                i += 1
+                if i >= len(argv):
+                    raise EzaError(f"Missing value for argument --{word}")
+                val = argv[i]
+            elif need == "optional" and val is None:
+                val = {"classify":"auto","icons":"auto","color":"auto","colour":"auto","absolute":"on","color-scale":"all","colour-scale":"all"}.get(word)
+            set_opt(opt, word, val)
+        elif a.startswith("-") and a != "-":
+            cluster = a[1:]
+            j = 0
+            while j < len(cluster):
+                ch = cluster[j]
+                if ch not in SHORTS:
+                    raise EzaError(f"Unknown argument -{ch}")
+                word = SHORTS[ch]
+                need = TAKES.get(word, "forbidden")
+                val = None
+                if need in ("required", "optional"):
+                    rest = cluster[j+1:]
+                    if rest.startswith("="):
+                        rest = rest[1:]
+                    if rest:
+                        val = rest
+                        j = len(cluster)
+                    elif need == "required":
+                        i += 1
+                        if i >= len(argv):
+                            raise EzaError(f"Missing value for argument -{ch}")
+                        val = argv[i]
+                    else:
+                        val = "auto"
+                    set_opt(opt, word, val)

+def bad_arg(flag, val, choices):
+    long = "--" + flag
+    short = {v:k for k,v in SHORTS.items()}.get(flag)

+def set_opt(o, w, v):

+    elif w == "grid": o.mode = "grid"
+    elif w == "across": o.mode = "grid"
+    elif w == "recurse": o.recurse = True
+    elif w == "tree": o.tree = True; o.recurse = True
+    elif w == "dereference": o.deref = True
+    elif w == "follow-symlinks": o.deref = True
+    elif w == "classify":
+        if v not in ("always","auto","never"): raise bad_arg("classify", v, "always, auto, never")
+        o.classify = v
+    elif w in ("color","colour"):
+        if v not in ("always","auto","never"): raise bad_arg("color", v, "always, auto, never")
+        o.color = v
+    elif w in ("color-scale","colour-scale","color-scale-mode","colour-scale-mode","hyperlink","git","no-git","git-repos","git-repos-no-status","git-ignore","mounts","flags","extended","context","total-size","smart-group"):
+        pass
+    elif w == "icons":
+        if v not in ("always","auto","never"): raise bad_arg("icons", v, "always, auto, never")
+        o.icons = v
+    elif w == "no-quotes": o.no_quotes = True
+    elif w == "absolute":
+        if v not in ("on","follow","off"): raise bad_arg("absolute", v, "on, follow, off")

+    elif w == "width": o.width = int(v)
+    elif w in ("all","almost-all"):
+        o.all_count += 1 if w == "all" else 1
+    elif w in ("treat-dirs-as-files","list-dirs"): o.dirs_as_files = True
+    elif w == "only-dirs": o.only_dirs = True
+    elif w == "only-files": o.only_files = True
+    elif w == "show-symlinks": o.show_symlinks = True
+    elif w == "no-symlinks": o.no_symlinks = True
+    elif w == "level": o.level = int(v)
+    elif w == "reverse": o.reverse = True
+    elif w == "sort":
+        mp = {"name":"name","Name":"Name","size":"size","extension":"extension","Extension":"Extension","modified":"modified","changed":"changed","accessed":"accessed","created":"created","date":"modified","time":"modified","new":"modified","newest":"modified","old":"age","oldest":"age","age":"age","inode":"inode","type":"type","none":"none"}
+        matches = [val for key,val in mp.items() if key.startswith(v)]

+    elif w == "blocksize": pass

+@dataclass
+class Entry:
+    path: str
+    name: str
+    display_path: str
+    st: object | None
+    is_dir: bool
+    is_link: bool
+
+
+def stat_entry(path, deref=False):
+    try:
+        st = os.stat(path) if deref else os.lstat(path)
+        is_link = os.path.islink(path)
+        is_dir = stat.S_ISDIR((os.stat(path).st_mode if is_link and deref else st.st_mode))
+        return st, is_dir, is_link
+    except OSError:
+        return None, False, os.path.islink(path)
+
+
+def make_entry(path, name=None, display_path=None, opt=None):
+    st, is_dir, is_link = stat_entry(path, opt.deref if opt else False)
+    nm = name if name is not None else os.path.basename(path.rstrip(os.sep)) or path
+    disp = display_path if display_path is not None else path
+    return Entry(path, nm, disp, st, is_dir, is_link)
+
+
+def visible(e, opt):
+    if opt.all_count == 0 and e.name.startswith('.'):
+        return False
+    if opt.no_symlinks and e.is_link:
+        return False
+    if opt.only_dirs and not e.is_dir and not (opt.show_symlinks and e.is_link):
+        return False
+    if opt.only_files and e.is_dir and not (opt.show_symlinks and e.is_link):
+        return False
+    return not any(fnmatch.fnmatch(e.name, p) for p in opt.ignore)
+
+
+def list_dir(path, opt):
+    out = []
+    if opt.all_count >= 2:
+        out.append(make_entry(os.path.join(path, "."), ".", ".", opt))
+        out.append(make_entry(os.path.join(path, ".."), "..", "..", opt))
+    try:
+        with os.scandir(path) as it:
+            for de in it:
+                e = make_entry(de.path, de.name, de.name, opt)
+                if visible(e, opt):
+                    out.append(e)
+    except OSError as exc:
+        raise RuntimeError(format_os_error(path, exc))
+    sort_entries(out, opt)
+    return out
+
+
+def sort_entries(entries, opt):
+    if opt.sort != "none":
+        def key(e):
+            st = e.st
+            if opt.sort == "Name": return nat_key(e.name, True)
+            if opt.sort == "extension": return (Path(e.name).suffix.lower(), nat_key(e.name))
+            if opt.sort == "Extension": return (Path(e.name).suffix, nat_key(e.name, True))
+            if opt.sort == "size": return (0 if st is None else st.st_size, nat_key(e.name))
+            if opt.sort in ("modified","age"): return (0 if st is None else st.st_mtime, nat_key(e.name))
+            if opt.sort == "accessed": return (0 if st is None else st.st_atime, nat_key(e.name))
+            if opt.sort == "created": return (0 if st is None else st.st_ctime, nat_key(e.name))
+            if opt.sort == "inode": return (0 if st is None else getattr(st, "st_ino", 0), nat_key(e.name))
+            if opt.sort == "type": return (type_char(e), nat_key(e.name))
+            return nat_key(e.name)
+        entries.sort(key=key, reverse=(opt.reverse ^ (opt.sort in ("size","modified"))))
+    if opt.group_first:
+        entries.sort(key=lambda e: not e.is_dir)
+    if opt.group_last:
+        entries.sort(key=lambda e: e.is_dir)
+
+
+def type_char(e):
+    if e.is_dir: return "d"
+    if e.is_link: return "l"
+    if e.st and (e.st.st_mode & 0o111): return "x"
+    return "-"
+
+
+def format_os_error(path, exc):
+    return f"{quote_name(path)}: {exc.strerror or exc} (os error {getattr(exc, 'winerror', None) or exc.errno})"
+
+
+def perm_string(e):
+    if os.name == "nt":
+        return "d----" if e.is_dir else "-a---"
+    if e.st is None:
+        return "----------"
+    mode = e.st.st_mode
+    chars = ["d" if stat.S_ISDIR(mode) else "l" if stat.S_ISLNK(mode) else "-"]
+    for who in (6,3,0):
+        bits = (mode >> who) & 7
+        chars += ["r" if bits&4 else "-", "w" if bits&2 else "-", "x" if bits&1 else "-"]
+    return "".join(chars)
+
+
+def size_string(e, opt):
+    if e.st is None: return "-"
+    n = e.st.st_size
+    if opt.bytes: return str(n)
+    units = [(1<<40,"Ti"),(1<<30,"Gi"),(1<<20,"Mi"),(1<<10,"Ki")] if opt.binary else [(10**12,"T"),(10**9,"G"),(10**6,"M"),(10**3,"k")]
+    for base, unit in units:
+        if n >= base:
+            val = n / base
+            return (f"{val:.1f}" if val < 10 else f"{val:.0f}") + unit
+    return str(n)
+
+
+def time_string(e, opt):
+    if e.st is None: return "-"
+    ts = e.st.st_mtime
+    if opt.time_field == "accessed": ts = e.st.st_atime
+    elif opt.time_field in ("created","changed"): ts = e.st.st_ctime
+    if opt.time_style == "long-iso": return time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", time.localtime(ts))
+    if opt.time_style == "full-iso": return time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S", time.localtime(ts))
+    if opt.time_style == "iso": return time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d", time.localtime(ts))
+    if opt.time_style.startswith("+"):
+        return time.strftime(opt.time_style[1:], time.localtime(ts))
+    return time.strftime("%d %b %H:%M", time.localtime(ts))
+
+
+def file_name(e, opt):
+    name = e.display_path if opt.absolute == "off" else os.path.abspath(e.path)
+    name = quote_name(name, opt.no_quotes)
+    if opt.icons == "always":
+        name = icon_for(e.path, e.is_dir) + " " + name
+    if opt.classify == "always":
+        if e.is_dir: name += os.sep
+        elif e.is_link: name += "@"
+        elif e.st and e.st.st_mode & 0o111: name += "*"
+    return name
+
+
+def render_lines(entries, opt):
+    return "".join(file_name(e, opt) + "\n" for e in entries)
+
+
+def render_grid(entries, opt):
+    if not entries: return ""
+    names = [file_name(e, opt) for e in entries]
+    widths = [display_width(n) for n in names]
+    maxw = max(widths) + 2
+    cols = max(1, opt.width // maxw)
+    rows = (len(names) + cols - 1) // cols
+    lines = []
+    for r in range(rows):
+        parts = []
+        for c in range(cols):
+            idx = c * rows + r
+            if idx >= len(names): continue
+            s = names[idx]
+            if c != cols - 1 and idx + rows < len(names):
+                s += " " * (maxw - display_width(s))
+            parts.append(s)
+        lines.append("".join(parts).rstrip())
+    return "\n".join(lines) + "\n"
+
+
+def render_long(entries, opt):
+    rows = []
+    if opt.header:
+        hdr = []
+        hdr.append("Permissions")
+        if opt.links: hdr.append("Links")
+        if opt.inode: hdr.append("Inode")
+        if opt.show_size: hdr.append("Size")
+        if opt.show_user: hdr.append("User")
+        if opt.show_group: hdr.append("Group")
+        if opt.show_time: hdr.append("Date Modified")
+        hdr.append("Name")
+        rows.append(" ".join(hdr))
+    for e in entries:
+        cols = [perm_string(e)]
+        if opt.links: cols.append(str(0 if e.st is None else getattr(e.st, "st_nlink", 1)))
+        if opt.inode: cols.append(str(0 if e.st is None else getattr(e.st, "st_ino", 0)))
+        if opt.show_size: cols.append(size_string(e, opt))
+        if opt.show_user: cols.append("-")
+        if opt.show_group: cols.append("-")
+        if opt.show_time: cols.append(time_string(e, opt))
+        cols.append(file_name(e, opt))
+        rows.append(" ".join(cols))
+    return "\n".join(rows) + ("\n" if rows else "")
+
+
+def render(entries, opt):
+    if opt.long or opt.mode == "long": return render_long(entries, opt)
+    if opt.mode == "lines" or opt.recurse: return render_lines(entries, opt)
+    return render_grid(entries, opt)
+
+
+def tree_prefix(stack, last):
+    out = ""
+    for is_last in stack[:-1]:
+        out += "    " if is_last else "│   "
+    if stack:
+        out += "└── " if last else "├── "
+    return out
+
+
+def render_tree(root, opt, depth=0, stack=None):
+    stack = stack or []
+    e = make_entry(root, os.path.basename(root.rstrip(os.sep)) or root, root if depth == 0 else os.path.basename(root), opt)
+    out = (tree_prefix(stack, stack[-1] if stack else True) + file_name(e, opt) + "\n")
+    if opt.level is not None and depth >= opt.level:
+        return out
+    if not e.is_dir:
+        return out
+    try:
+        kids = list_dir(root, opt)
+    except RuntimeError as exc:
+        return out + str(exc) + "\n"
+    kids = [k for k in kids if k.name not in (".", "..")]
+    for idx, k in enumerate(kids):
+        last = idx == len(kids)-1
+        if k.is_dir:
+            out += render_tree(k.path, opt, depth+1, stack+[last])
+        else:
+            out += tree_prefix(stack+[last], last) + file_name(k, opt) + "\n"
+    return out
+
+
+def collect_paths(paths, opt):
+    files, dirs, errors = [], [], []
+    for p in paths:
+        e = make_entry(p, None, p, opt)
+        if e.st is None:
+            try: os.lstat(p)
+            except OSError as exc: errors.append(format_os_error(p, exc)); continue
+        if e.is_dir and not opt.dirs_as_files:
+            dirs.append(p)
+        else:
+            files.append(e)
+    sort_entries(files, opt)
+    return files, dirs, errors
+

+def run(argv):
+    opt, paths = parse(argv)
+    if opt.stdin and not paths:
+        sep = os.environ.get("EZA_STDIN_SEPARATOR", "\n")
+        paths = [p for p in sys.stdin.read().split(sep) if p]

+import os
+import random
+import shutil
+import string
+import subprocess
+import sys
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+OFFICIAL = Path((ROOT / "REFERENCE_BINARY.txt").read_text().strip())
+PORT = ROOT / "executable"
+
+
+def rng_name(rng, prefix="f"):
+    alphabet = string.ascii_lowercase + string.digits
+    return prefix + "".join(rng.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(rng.randint(2, 8)))
+
+
+def build_tree(base, rng):
+    names = ["a", "b", "file10", "file2", ".hidden", "two words"]
+    for _ in range(10):
+        names.append(rng_name(rng))
+    for idx, name in enumerate(names):
+        p = base / name
+        p.write_text((name + "\n") * (idx % 5), encoding="utf-8")
+    for dname in ["dir", "zdir", rng_name(rng, "d")]:
+        d = base / dname
+        d.mkdir()
+        for i in range(3):
+            (d / f"child{i}").write_text("x" * (i + 1), encoding="utf-8")
+    return names
+
+
+def run(cmd, cwd, stdin=""):
+    return subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=cwd, input=stdin.encode(), stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+
+
+def compare(label, argv, cwd, stdin=""):
+    oracle = run([str(OFFICIAL), *argv], cwd, stdin)
+    actual = run([sys.executable, str(PORT), *argv], cwd, stdin)
+    same = (oracle.returncode, oracle.stdout, oracle.stderr) == (actual.returncode, actual.stdout, actual.stderr)
+    if not same:
+        print(f"FAIL {label}: {' '.join(argv)}")
+        print(f"official status={oracle.returncode} stdout={oracle.stdout[:400]!r} stderr={oracle.stderr[:400]!r}")
+        print(f"port     status={actual.returncode} stdout={actual.stdout[:400]!r} stderr={actual.stderr[:400]!r}")
+        return False
+    return True
+
+
+def valid_samples(tmp, rng):
+    groups = {
+        "meta": [["--version"], ["--help"]],
+        "lines": [],
+        "grid": [],
+        "tree": [],
+        "long": [],
+        "filters": [],
+        "sorts": [],
+    }
+    sort_values = ["name", "Name", "size", "extension", "Extension", "modified", "accessed", "created", "inode", "type", "none"]
+    for i in range(16):
+        target = "." if i % 4 else "dir"
+        groups["lines"].append([target, "--color=never", "--icons=never", "-1"])
+        groups["grid"].append([target, "--color=never", "--icons=never", "--width", str(rng.choice([40, 60, 80, 100]))])
+        groups["tree"].append([".", "--color=never", "--icons=never", "-T", "-L", str(rng.choice([1, 2]))])
+        groups["long"].append([target, "--color=never", "--icons=never", "-l", "--no-user", "--no-time", "--no-filesize"])
+        groups["filters"].append([".", "--color=never", "--icons=never", rng.choice(["-a", "-D", "-f", "--ignore-glob"]), rng.choice(["*.zz", "file*", "child*"])])
+        groups["sorts"].append([".", "--color=never", "--icons=never", "-1", "--sort", rng.choice(sort_values)])
+    for name, samples in groups.items():
+        take = samples if name == "meta" else samples[:16]
+        for idx, argv in enumerate(take):
+            yield f"valid:{name}:{idx}", argv
+
+
+def invalid_samples(rng):
+    invalids = []
+    for i in range(16):
+        invalids.append([rng.choice(["--definitely-not-eza", "-q", "--sort=bad", "--icons=wat", "--color=nope"])])
+    for i in range(16):
+        invalids.append([rng_name(rng, "missing")])
+    for idx, argv in enumerate(invalids):
+        yield f"invalid:{idx}", argv
+
+
+def main():
+    seed = int(os.environ.get("VERIFIER_SEED", str(random.randrange(1_000_000))))
+    rng = random.Random(seed)
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="eza-port-") as td:
+        tmp = Path(td)
+        build_tree(tmp, rng)
+        failures = 0
+        for label, argv in valid_samples(tmp, rng):
+            if not compare(label, argv, tmp):
+                failures += 1
+        for label, argv in invalid_samples(rng):
+            if not compare(label, argv, tmp):
+                failures += 1
+        if failures:
+            print(f"seed={seed} failures={failures}")
+            return 1
+        print(f"seed={seed} generated differential checks passed")
+        return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
*** End Patch

+import re
+import shlex
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+
+ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
+REF = ROOT / "rust-reference"
+OFFICIAL = Path((ROOT / "REFERENCE_BINARY.txt").read_text().strip())
+PORT = ROOT / "executable"
+
+
+def fixture_args(path):
+    text = path.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
+    m = re.search(r'^args\s*=\s*"(.*)"\s*$', text, re.M)
+    if not m:
+        return None
+    return shlex.split(m.group(1), posix=False)
+
+
+def run(cmd):
+    return subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=REF, stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
+
+
+def main():
+    failures = 0
+    count = 0
+    for toml in sorted((REF / "tests" / "cmd").glob("*.toml")):
+        argv = fixture_args(toml)
+        if argv is None:
+            continue
+        count += 1
+        oracle = run([str(OFFICIAL), *argv])
+        actual = run([sys.executable, str(PORT), *argv])
+        if (oracle.returncode, oracle.stdout, oracle.stderr) != (actual.returncode, actual.stdout, actual.stderr):
+            failures += 1
+            print(f"FAIL {toml.name}: {' '.join(argv)}")
+            print(f"official status={oracle.returncode} stdout={oracle.stdout[:300]!r} stderr={oracle.stderr[:300]!r}")
+            print(f"port     status={actual.returncode} stdout={actual.stdout[:300]!r} stderr={actual.stderr[:300]!r}")
+    if failures:
+        print(f"cmd fixtures compared={count} failures={failures}")
+        return 1
+    print(f"cmd fixtures compared={count} passed")
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
*** End Patch
